data.one_liner: Material 3 Expressive Loading Indicator featuring morphing polygons for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Material 3 Expressive Loading Indicator widget that continuously rotates and morphs between polygon shapes. It includes both Default and Contained variants with token-aligned sizes and colors.
use_when: You want to use Material 3 Expressive design loading indicators with morphing polygon animations.
Your project already uses the m3e_design monorepo setup and material_new_shapes.
avoid_when: You need a standard simple circular progress indicator without polygon morphing or monorepo token dependencies.
You are looking for a non-Material loading animation widget from the standard pub registry without local package paths.
strengths: Implements Material 3 Expressive morphing polygon loading indicator matching Compose behavior.
Supports customizable colors and custom polygon sequences.
Includes accessibility support through semantic labels.
weaknesses: Requires local monorepo dependencies (m3e_design and material_new_shapes).
Very specific to Material 3 Expressive style and may not fit standard Material 2 apps.
data.setup_notes: Requires local or path dependencies setup for m3e_design and material_new_shapes within a monorepo structure.

alternatives.name: loading_animation_widget
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a wide collection of ready-to-use loading animations without complex monorepo setup.
